title: record page: the read-only field copy button is a Tab stop that stays invisible (hover-only reveal), like the inline-edit pencil before #25883
body:
Filing class: ① a user-visible defect (class a, public door: any record page in desktop read mode). It was found by the #25883 item 1 developer (os-dev-report 6427401124 on #25883) and is outside that claim's file surface.

## What
In `ui/packages/plugin-detail/src/DetailSection.tsx`, the copy-to-clipboard button on a read-only, copyable field (around `:772` on `main`) has `opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100` and nothing else. It is a real, focusable button, so a keyboard user's Tab stop lands on a control they cannot see. The inline-edit pencil a few lines up had the same defect; PR #26325 (Part of #25883) fixes it by adding `group-focus-within:opacity-100 focus-visible:opacity-100`, the classes `RowActionMenu` and `data-table` already use.

## Expected
The copy button is revealed on keyboard focus as well as on hover, in the same way. Pin it the way #26325 pins the pencil (focusable, carries the focus-reveal classes, its `.group` is its own field), since jsdom has no layout.

## Sequencing
The same file as #26325, on the plugin-detail landing line (#26055 → #26277 → #26325). Claim it after #26325 merges.

## Related, noted, not in this card
- The pencil's aria-label and tooltip read "Double-click to edit", which does not match keyboard activation. Fixing that needs a new key in every locale pack.
- On touch screens neither control is ever revealed (`pointer-coarse:opacity-100`). That belongs with the mobile read row's edit path.
